m-eurosat.summary: Ran two full 10-epoch runs (bs 64, lr 3e-3, augmentation) because the budget allowed only 2 experiments. cnn_small reached 0.902 val accuracy, and resnet_small reached 0.878. Both curves were still improving at the end, so more epochs would probably help. I selected cnn_small (exp-20261031T175718Z-2acce6). The two models differ by only one seed and a short schedule, so the gap may not be reliable.
